verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a product-analytics platform, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Heap offering a self-hosted or on-premises deployment. The docs describe only a hosted SaaS model: a JS snippet that sends data to Heap, server-side APIs into Heap, and tiered cloud pricing plans.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
